The act of kindness is an invariable beneficial force surrounding those who mobilize it. There are imponderable edifying energies around those who keep the flame of good thoughts alive to illuminate the path of others through stimulating and wholesome conversation.

The psychic elements we exteriorize through the mouth are active powers in our name, acting factors that operate under our responsibility, on a near or remote plane, according to our most secret intentions.
It is imperative to watch the mouth, because the word creates, insinuates, inclines, modifies, renews, or destroys through the living expansion of our personality.
In all the days and events of life, let us remember with the Divine Master that the word proceeds from the heart and, for this very reason, defiles man.

messages.title: Prayer Recomposes
paragraphs: “And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together.” — (ACTS, 4.31)
In the construction of a simple stone house, long effort must be expended to adjust the proper environment, removing obstacles, eliminating roughness, and improving the landscape.
When it is not necessary to level rough ground, it is often required to fill in the earth, forming a secure bed upon a strong foundation.
Various instruments move methodically in the renewing work.
So it is also in the sphere of thoughts of a spiritual order.

In the edification of domestic peace, the realization of generous ideals, and the unfolding of edifying services, we must urgently provide resources for general understanding, with a view toward cooperation, responsibility, and the process of essential action. And, undoubtedly, prayer represents the indispensable renewing lever, removing obstacles in the hard terrain of misunderstanding.
Prayer is the divine voice of the spirit in the great silence.

It is not always characterized by articulated sounds in verbal conceptualization, but invariably, it is a prodigious spiritual power communicating emotions and thoughts, images and ideas, dissolving impediments, clearing roads, reforming conceptions, and improving the mental framework in which it is our duty to fulfill the task to which the Father calls us.

Often, in the struggles of the sincere disciple of the Gospel, the majority of acquaintances do not understand his purposes, friends desert, family members yield to shadow and ignorance; however, it is enough for him to take refuge in the sanctuary of his own life, emitting the beneficial energies of love and understanding, so that the place where he lingers with his own may move toward the higher realm.

Prayer woven of restlessness and anguish cannot distance itself from the disordered cries of those who prefer affliction and yield to imprudence, but prayer woven of harmony and trust is a force imparting direction to the compass of living faith, recomposing the landscape in which we live and tracing new paths for the higher life.

messages.title: Along the Diverse Paths
paragraphs: “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” — PAUL (2 Corinthians, 13.5)
Diverse attitudes characterize the students of the New Revelation.
Those who remain on the periphery of the teachings demand new phenomenological demonstrations, without any purpose of inner renewal.
Those who linger in the region of the letter cherish long discussions without real profit.
How many prefer the zone of sectarianism, launching into lamentable and cruel struggles of separatism?
All those who crystallize in the "self" slumber in endless petitions, demanding undue protection, postponing the solution of their spiritual problems.
Those who delay in passionate delusions beg for food for their emotions, keeping themselves distant from legitimate understanding.
Those who throw themselves into the currents of negative sadness spend their time in sterile lamentations.

Those who consecrate themselves to the cult of doubt lose the opportunity of divine edification within themselves, turning into gratuitous critics, wounding companions, and tearing reputations to pieces.
How many cling to chronic curiosity, fluttering here and far, far from serious and necessary work?
Those who rejoice in presumption spend the day lashing their neighbor, as if they were permanent inquisitors of the world.
Those who live in faith, however, accompany Christ, examine themselves, and test themselves, turning into reflectors of the Divine Will, faithfully fulfilling it on the path of redemption.

messages.title: Let Your Light Shine
paragraphs: My friend, along the vast path of Earth, each creature seeks the spiritual nourishment corresponding to its evolutionary position.
The bee sucks the flower, the vulture claims scraps, man seeks emotions. But even in the realm of emotions, each Spirit demands special types.

There are inveterate sufferers who demand nothing other than suffering, pessimists who enclose themselves in dark clouds, attending to a deliberate purpose for centuries. They feed their minds with continuous tortures and pretend to construct nothing except the pity of others, in which they take delight.
We have ironists and laughter-seekers who merely ask for motives for the sarcasm upon which they feed.
We observe disputants who devour respectable pages with the sole objective of gathering contradictions to sustain endless polemics.
We notice sickly temperaments who sip intellectual toxins through less-than-worthy books, with the incomprehensible joy of one who drinks poisoned liquor.
In the varied climates of the world, there are those who nourish themselves on sadness, isolation, cheap pleasure, revolt, conflicts, calculations, afflictions, lies...

The disciple of Jesus, however—that man who has already grown weary of the deteriorated substances of transient experience—asks for the light of wisdom in order to learn to sow love in the company of the Master...
For the companions who await renewed life in Christ, hungry for eternal clarity, the pages of this unassuming book were written.
Within it, there are no words of sibylline revelation.
It translates simply into an effort for us to integrate ourselves into the Gospel, the divine granary of our bread of immortality.
It is neither exhortation nor prophecy. It is merely an invitation.
An invitation to sanctifying work, planned in the Code of Divine Love.

If the candle illuminates by burning its own oil, if the lamp shines by consuming the energy that the power plant supplies to it, let us offer the instrumentality of our lives to the imperatives of perfection, so that the Lord's teaching may reveal itself through us, clearing the path of our fellow men.
The Gospel is the Sun of Immortality that Spiritism reflects, with wisdom, for the present age of the world.
Let your light shine! — proclaimed the Master. Let us strive to shine! — we repeat.
